strategy.observation: Transistor reported 24% year-over-year growth in new customers in the month before its growth article.
strategy.offer_link: If some of that growth is coming from B2B brands starting podcasts, an editing-and-show-notes service could complement Transistor's hosting and give its Partnerships Lead a potential service partner to consider.
hypotheses: Some of Transistor's new customers may be B2B brands that want help producing episodes and show notes.
Transistor may be interested in partner services that add value for those customers.
strategy.angle: Transistor reported 24% year-over-year growth in new customers in the month before its growth article; I wondered whether a production partner for B2B podcasters could complement that growth.
strategy.fit_reason: Podcast editing and show notes are adjacent to Transistor's hosting business, but the facts don't establish that its new customers are B2B brands or that it is seeking service partners.

draft.subject: Production support for new podcasters
draft.body:
Hi,

I saw Transistor reported 24% year-over-year growth in new customers in the month before its growth article. I wondered if some of that momentum is bringing in B2B brands that want help getting episodes ready to publish.

I provide podcast audio editing and show notes for B2B brands, so I could be a production partner for customers who need support beyond hosting. Are you exploring partner options for B2B podcasters as your customer base grows?
